breakdown.description: The prompt states significant losses but then assumes an ideal lossless Venturi (Cd=1).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not fix the Cd=1 assumption. Instead of correcting it to Cd<1 (as the ground truth requires), the agent merely asks a vague clarifying question about industry/application. It does not address the contradiction between significant losses and ideal Bernoulli, nor does it provide the corrected formula with a discharge coefficient less than 1.
